title: Law to let residents sue over AI rule violations
summary: This bill would let any person file a complaint with the Department of Consumer and Worker Protection alleging a violation of the city's artificial intelligence laws. The department must investigate unless the complaint is frivolous or duplicative, and share it with the Law Department. People who file complaints that lead to enforcement could receive 25 percent of any money recovered, or 50 percent if they are authorized to bring the case themselves.
